info.title: Teleman Telemarketing API
info.description: RESTful API for Teleman telemarketing platform. Integrate with CRM, ERP, and other business applications.

post.description: Create a new campaign. When phone_number_id is provided, the system automatically checks if that phone number has an active AI agent assigned and will auto-assign the ai_agent_id to the campaign.

message.example: Hello {first_name}, we have a special offer for you!

phone_number_id.description: Phone number ID - AI agent will be auto-assigned if phone has one

201.description: Campaign created successfully. ai_agent_id will be populated automatically if phone number has an active AI agent.

put.description: Update campaign. When changing phone_number_id, the system automatically updates ai_agent_id based on the new phone number. If the new phone has no AI agent, ai_agent_id will be set to null.

phone_number_id.description: Change phone number - AI agent will be auto-updated

200.description: Campaign updated successfully. ai_agent_id updated automatically based on phone number.

ai_agent_id.description: AI agent automatically assigned based on phone number (read-only)

phone_number.description: Phone number assigned to this AI agent

description.example: Handles customer inquiries and sales calls

system_prompt.description: System instructions for AI agent behavior

sanctum.description: Enter your API token in the format: Bearer {token}

tags.name: Authentication
tags.description: API authentication and token management endpoints
